steps.notes: session boot on an empty store

elements.name: Alchamancer 2
elements.summary: solo-mage tactical-grid roguelike in from-scratch C; Hades-style single player now, the original 1v1 duel later on the same sim core

elements.name: sim_apply
elements.summary: the one mutation entry point: sim_apply(State, Command) -> Events; player input, AI, and future netcode all emit the same Commands

elements.name: pure sim core

attrs.reason: buys replays, undo, deterministic tests, and turn-based netcode from one discipline

elements.summary: game state changes only via sim_apply; no I/O in the sim, integer math only

elements.name: assets are text

attrs.reason: no binary art or audio in the repo; everything diffs

elements.summary: sprites are .txt 16x16 palette grids; music and SFX are .mml chiptune text synthesized to PCM at runtime

elements.name: no game engine

attrs.reason: Carmack methodology: thin hand-rolled per-OS backend behind one platform.h

elements.summary: no engine, no SDL; Xlib+ALSA on Linux, Win32+WASAPI on Windows, everything above the line portable C

steps.notes: core concepts + standing constraints from README/PRD

elements.name: platform layer
elements.summary: one per-OS system layer behind platform.h; Linux Xlib+ALSA now, Windows in Phase J, macOS deferred

attrs.rejected: building the macOS backend alongside Linux
attrs.reason: ship Linux and Windows/Steam first; a third backend now buys nothing

elements.name: damage formula
elements.summary: pinned integer math, fixed evaluation order: dmg = 22*power*atk/def/50, then field mod x100, then affinity x100, min 1; test-vector locked

attrs.chose: PRD small-power scale: Spark about 5, hero 30 HP, enemies 4-18 HP
attrs.reason: original powers were tuned for a gridless 1v1 with HP in the hundreds, untuned for grid enemies

attrs.chose: about 16-18 waves, 40-50 minutes, Act2 picks 2 schools
